subject: Directory synchronization, admin-role mapping and audit controls - questionnaire
messages:
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@corposys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Corposys IT Security <it_security@corposys.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T15:12:00Z
Subject: Directory synchronization and admin ops questionnaire for Redwood

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for agreeing to take our IAM questionnaire. Corposys is preparing an RFP shortlist and we need clarity on a few items before next Tuesday's security review. High-level asks below; I attached the Excel of our canonical fields. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports the following and provide any limitations/notes?

1) SCIM provisioning
 - Can clients map external directory groups to Redwood admin roles (e.g., map AD group `corp-admins` -> Redwood `org_admin`)?
 - Does your SCIM implementation support partial updates and delta syncs (i.e., only send changed users/groups)?
 - Can SCIM be restricted to a source IP / allowlist or limited to specific enterprise connection IDs?

2) SSO options
 - SAML and OIDC supported? Any functionality gaps (group assertions, role mappings, NameID formatting)?

3) RBAC and delegation
 - Can admins create nested admin roles, or is it flat role assignment only?
 - Is there an API to programmatically create/assign roles?

4) Audit & evidence
 - What audit events are captured for provisioning (create/update/delete), role assignment changes, and SSO logins?
 - Timestamp granularity and retention period for audit logs (we need 13 months minimum).

5) Exports & samples
 - Can you provide a sample SCIM mapping file and an example CSV of group-to-role mappings?

If you can attach a short PDF answering these points and a sample mapping, that would be ideal. If there's anything sensitive (SOC2 artifacts) we can get to your security contact via an NDA/secure transfer.

Thanks — appreciate a short reply with the key constraints so we can proceed.

— Alex
Alex Moore
Head of IT Security, Corposys Financial
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@corposys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T19:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Directory synchronization and admin ops questionnaire for Redwood

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We can cover everything you asked; see inline answers below and I attached a short PDF (Redwood_IAM_QA_20270425.pdf) plus a small SCIM mapping sample (CSV). Quick summary up front: SCIM supports group->role mapping, delta sync, and allowlist by enterprise connector ID; SAML + OIDC both supported; RBAC supports hierarchical roles via role inheritance features and there is a full management API. Audit logs retain 18 months by default for enterprise customers (13 months configurable minimum).

Inline: 
1) SCIM provisioning
 - Group->role mapping: yes. You can map external group attributes to Redwood role IDs. We support attribute-based mapping and explicit group-to-role tables.
 - Delta syncs: yes — our SCIM connector supports incremental changes (PATCH / BulkChange handling) and a polling delta endpoint for connectors that prefer polling.
 - Restrict SCIM: SCIM connectors are bound to an enterprise connector ID and can be limited to specific connector IDs and static IP ranges via VPC egress policies or our on-prem connector.

2) SSO options
 - SAML & OIDC supported. SAML supports group assertions (AttributeStatement) and customizable NameID (email or persistent). OIDC supports groups in the ID token or via a SCIM-backed group sync if preferred.

3) RBAC and delegation
 - Role model: supports role inheritance (you can create a parent role that includes child roles).
 - API: full REST management APIs to create roles, assign roles to users/groups, and audit assignments.

4) Audit & evidence
 - Events captured: user provision, deprovision, group create/update/delete, role create/update/assignment, SSO login attempts (success/failure), and token/key rotations.
 - Timestamps: millisecond precision recorded (ISO 8601 UTC). Retention: 18 months for Dedicated/Private; hosted customers default to 12 months but can be configured to 13+ months under contract.

5) Exports & samples
 - Attached sample: Redwood_SCIM_Mapping_Sample.csv (group_to_role mappings) and a one-page PDF summary.

Next steps: I attached the artifacts. If you'd like, we can book a 30‑minute session to walk Marissa (implementation) and your SSO team through the mapping and connector options. I copied Karthik who owns the SCIM connector implementation and Marissa for commercial/ops questions.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_IAM_QA_20270425.pdf (PDF summary) — 84 KB; Redwood_SCIM_Mapping_Sample.csv (CSV sample) — 4 KB
From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@corposys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Corposys IT Security <it_security@corposys.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Directory synchronization and admin ops questionnaire for Redwood

Jonas — thanks for the fast reply and attachments. A few clarifying Qs from our engineering and audit teams: 

• For delta syncs — do you provide a change token (cursor) or do you rely on timestamp-based diffs? Is there any window where the connector will re-send unchanged records?
• For group->role mapping — can mapping rules include attribute conditions (e.g., if department=finance and group=managers then map->finance_manager)?
• Audit retention — you mentioned 18 months for Dedicated/Private. For your hosted offering, can we negotiate 13 months minimum in contract language for retention of provisioning events and SSO logs?
• SOC2 / evidence request — our procurement needs a secure link for SOC2 artifacts. Is there a secure portal or can you provide a presigned S3 link?

Also please provide a sample CSV showing an attribute-rule example if possible (the attached CSV was a straight table). If it's easier we can do a short call; we have time Tue 4/27 afternoon PST.

— Alex
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@corposys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T18:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Directory synchronization and admin ops questionnaire for Redwood

Alex — quick answers inline, and I attached an attribute-rule sample CSV and a secure link for SOC2 artifacts.

• Change token vs timestamp: we provide a change cursor for our SCIM connector (opaque token) and the connector SDK exposes a delta token; connectors that poll can also rely on timestamp diffs but the token is preferred to avoid replays.
• Attribute-based rules: supported — our mapping engine supports boolean expressions on user/group attributes (department, location, custom claims). Example in attached CSV: `if department=="finance" and group=="managers" => finance_manager`.
• Hosted retention: we can commit to 13 months of provisioning/SSO event retention in our Enterprise DPA/SLA for Corposys if included in the contract — I'll route this to legal and include in the DocuSign SLA wizard.
• SOC2 evidence: we have a secure artifacts portal. I created a presigned link for your procurement team and attached DocuSign SLA for signature (DocuSign_SLA_CPS-7124.pdf). Portal: https://redwood.example/security/evidence/CPS-7124 (expires in 7 days).

If Tue 4/27 PST works, Karthik and I can join a 30-minute call at 3pm PST to review the mapping rules and connector options. Otherwise we'll do written follow up.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
